page: OVHcloud l4-180 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance within the Cloud GPU family, engineered for parallel compute tasks and machine learning acceleration. Virtualized via KVM, the system provides 45 dedicated physical cores based on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9454 processor clocked at 2.75 GHz. Hyperthreading is disabled, dedicating one single thread per physical core. Processor features include 64 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, 16 MB L3 cache, and instruction extensions such as AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16, alongside AES, VAES, and SHA-NI cryptographic extensions.

Hardware acceleration is powered by two NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPUs supplying a combined 48 GB of GDDR6 VRAM (24 GB per GPU). The host configuration pairs the dual accelerators with 180.0 GB of system memory, matching a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage includes a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and the network subsystem offers a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier compute and inference throughput. In CPU stress testing with stress-ng, both single-core (3,126.87) and multi-core (132,330.9) evaluations place the instance in the top 10 percent of evaluated systems. Large-model inference benchmarks highlight strong acceleration: small (135M) model prompt processing reaches 12,232.17 tokens per second, medium (7B) model processing achieves 2,768.53 tokens per second, and large (70B) model inference processes 262.6 prompt tokens per second, all registering in the top 10 percent.

With strong PassMark compute scores of 75,707.48 and PassMark memory performance ranking in the top 10 percent at 3,119.91, the server delivers high throughput per resource unit. A potential operational tradeoff is the 400 GB NVMe storage footprint, which necessitates external object or block storage for massive training sets. The instance is suited for enterprise LLM inference, video processing, ray tracing, distributed data processing, and high-concurrency database services.
description: OVHcloud l4-180 is a cloud GPU instance built on the x86_64 architecture, combining 45 dedicated AMD EPYC 9454 cores clocked at 2.75 GHz with dual NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPUs delivering 48 GB of total VRAM. The system features 180.0 GB of RAM, a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and a 16 Gbps baseline network interface. In synthetic tests, stress-ng multi-core and single-core CPU throughput rank in the top 10 percent, while PassMark memory bandwidth matches top-tier performance levels. LLM inference benchmarks record top-tier speed across small, medium, and 70B parameter models. Without simultaneous multithreading enabled, each vCPU maps to an independent physical core, maximizing per-thread predictability. The instance is suited for production AI inference, ray tracing, image and video processing, and concurrent computational workloads.
